notes:
v1.0.89 - Real server browser + Reimagined "R" nametag in-game
1) REAL SERVER BROWSER (Games > Servers): a curated directory of 15 real public Java servers (Hypixel, CubeCraft, Wynncraft, 2b2t, ManaCube, StoneHollow and more) - search by name/address/tag, filter by category, preview any server with live MOTD/players/version/latency, and a Recommended-for-you row ranked by the mods in your active profile.
2) INSTALL SERVERS INTO INSTANCES: pick a directory server and install it into any of your instances (searchable instance picker) - it is written into that instance's servers.dat, so it appears in the in-game Multiplayer list when you enter the game.
3) JOIN launches your active profile directly into the server. Favorites + recently-played history kept.
4) REIMAGINED "R" NAMETAG (FPS Boost 1.0.33, 26.2): the official fragmented Reimagined R now renders next to player nametags in-game - same brand identity as the launcher logo - with soft glow, smooth fade in/out, a Nametag R toggle in the FPS Boost screen, negligible perf cost and no conflicts with Sodium/Iris/Xaero's/Essential/Mod Menu.
